title: Security and privacy review
outcome: Explain security and privacy review using the deciding step in this fictional service.
scenario: Review a private note’s path. A revision service reads a learner’s private practice note; analytics need counts only.
given: Only the learner and assigned teacher may read note text. The dashboard is authorised for aggregate counts, not notes.

steps.label: Map content path
steps.detail: The authorised revision service receives the note.

steps.label: Check readers
steps.detail: The stated learner and teacher can retrieve its text.

steps.label: Minimise analytics
steps.detail: Send revision counts without copying private notes.

explanation: A privacy review follows data and authority through components. A useful dashboard does not automatically need every underlying private detail.

counterfactual.change: The dashboard starts storing full notes.
counterfactual.prediction: Flag the unapproved content path and remove it from the design.
counterfactual.reason: Its count-only purpose does not grant note-reading permission.

student_task: Trace private note content and analytics counts to their permitted readers. Why is storing full notes in the dashboard outside this design, and what risk can remain for tiny-group counts?
teacher_answer: The authorised revision service receives the note. The stated learner and teacher can retrieve its text. Send revision counts without copying private notes. Changed case: Flag the unapproved content path and remove it from the design. Its count-only purpose does not grant note-reading permission. Tiny-group counts can remain identifying, so minimise and review them too.
project_evidence: For the Grounded Learning Service, retain an annotated trace and the changed-case result. Name the contract or evidence that makes the deciding step valid, so another team can review it.
limits: Tiny-group aggregates can still reveal individuals; evaluate linkability, access and retention.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice, distinct from the reserved independent case. These stipulated records illustrate reasoning; no real service execution or learner outcome is claimed.
